items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: And his friend was named George, but I forget. He was living in the next block for me.

ctx.x: But see, in my days coming up, we didn't have much of a song to sing. You know what I was about?

What the time was it? That was in Tom Anderson. He used to wake up Tom Anderson all the time. Oh, well, I never thought of that. Yeah. I never thought of that. Yeah. I never thought of that. Yeah. I never thought of that. Yeah. I worked for him all the time when he was just coming out, going on or something. And it broke down. And his friend was named George, but I forget. He was living in the next block for me. When that man died, he was a millionaire. He had six to 15 and 30 years of a castle, property and…
Well, I ask him who some good drummers were in all this.
